BuildAid 1.0.0 - ready to test
Minecraft 26.2 / Fabric - client-side mod (works on any server)

The mod is available in English and Brazilian Portuguese. It follows the
language you pick in Minecraft - there is nothing to configure.


WHAT'S IN THIS FOLDER
---------------------
buildaid-1.1.0+26.2.jar            the mod
fabric-api-0.156.0+26.2.jar        required
cloth-config-fabric-26.2.155.jar   required (advanced settings screen)
modmenu-20.0.1.jar                 optional (adds the mod button in the mod list)


HOW TO INSTALL
--------------
1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 26.2:
   https://fabricmc.net/use/installer

2. Open the game folder:
   Windows key + R  ->  type  %appdata%\.minecraft  ->  Enter

3. Create a "mods" folder if there isn't one.

4. Copy the 4 .jar files from this folder into mods.

5. In the Minecraft launcher, pick the "fabric-loader-26.2" profile and play.

IMPORTANT: Minecraft 26.1 and newer require Java 25. If the game won't start,
that is almost always the reason. The launcher usually downloads the right
Java automatically.


QUICK TEST (1 minute)
---------------------
1. Join a world.

2. Press G. The BuildAid menu opens.

3. "Images" tab:
   - copy any image on your PC (Ctrl+C on a screenshot, in a browser, etc.)
   - click "Paste from clipboard"
   The image shows up in a floating panel.

4. Press G again -> "Panel" tab:
   - drag the opacity slider and watch the image fade
   - click "Adjust on screen" to move and resize it with the mouse
     (drag = move, blue corner = resize, right button = pan the image inside,
      wheel = zoom, R = reset, Esc = save)

5. Press B (selection mode on). Look at a block and press M: marks corner 1
   (blue). Look at another and press M: marks corner 2 (orange). The box shows
   up between them with its dimensions. Press B again and it all disappears.


THE 4 KEYS
----------
G   open the menu (everything is done from here)
H   show/hide the reference panel
B   toggle selection mode
M   mark a selection corner (while looking at a block)

Everything else (fullscreen overlay, next image, grid, info HUD, opacity, and
so on) lives in the menu. Those actions also show up under
Options -> Controls -> BuildAid, but with no key assigned: if you use one all
the time, just give it a key of your own.


WHERE YOUR FILES LIVE
---------------------
.minecraft\config\buildaid.json     all settings
.minecraft\config\buildaid\images\  the images you imported
